items.question: What specific object or mark situated at the forehead must be offered or recognized when acting in accordance with the preceding injunction?
premises: A mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass is to be identified here.
A count of a hundred thousand is linked to that mark.
An act already completed is tied to the one worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: The completed act directs a hundred-thousand mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass toward the one worshipped by the gods.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation between kṛtya and the preceding tokens remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having done the act, one brings a hundred-thousand mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass to the one worshipped by the gods.
